about.heading: About GEZE
about.paragraph1: The family-owned business GEZE began its operations in 1863. Over 160 years, the company has proven the quality of its products and services worldwide by utilizing innovative technologies in automatic doors, windows, and building automation, becoming a globally recognized name.
about.paragraph2: More than 3,000 employees work in GEZE branches around the world. The company has local offices in 37 countries and provides services to customers globally. All GEZE products are manufactured in compliance with international standards and hold globally recognized certifications.

collaboration.text: Persia Automatic Door Company, by maintaining consistency in service and product quality, remains dynamic and forward-looking toward new market developments. Our goal is to become a leading brand in the automatic door industry through continuous innovation, contributing to improved quality of life and safety while enhancing traffic infrastructure.

representative.subtitle: Official Representative of GEZE Products in Iran

hero.title: Industrial Solutions (Government Buildings)
hero.text: In government buildings and public institutions, selecting automatic doors is a key part of the security infrastructure. These facilities host large numbers of employees and visitors on a daily basis, and even the smallest system disruption can impact overall building security. Leveraging advanced GEZE technologies, Persiadoor delivers specialized solutions that enhance security, manage traffic flow, and ensure optimal performance in government facilities.

howSection.title: How Automatic Doors Support Your Operations

security.title: Secure Access Control
security.text: In ministries, organizations, and government offices, protecting information and controlling access are critical. By utilizing GEZE automatic door technologies, Persiadoor enables seamless integration of doors with access control systems.

accessibility.title: Traffic Management
accessibility.text: During office hours, the high volume of staff and visitor movement requires fast and intelligent systems. GEZE doors, equipped with precise sensors, high-speed operation, and adjustable settings, efficiently manage entry and exit, preventing queues and overcrowding.

efficiency.title: 24/7 Service and Support
efficiency.text: Through scheduled maintenance, round-the-clock support, and rapid on-site response, Persiadoor ensures that installed systems perform at their best and operate without interruption—even during peak hours in busy government facilities.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Private Facilities)
hero.text: GEZE automatic doors can be used in large residential complexes, towers, automobile showrooms, and similar environments. Aesthetics and security are of particular importance in these spaces. Therefore, PersiaDoor offers specially designed doors—such as decorative pivot hinged doors—to harmonize with the overall architectural design. GEZE products prioritize decorative appeal, enhanced security, and reliable emergency exit solutions for private facilities.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management and Security
hygiene.text: In residential complexes and large retail spaces, security is a top priority. PersiaDoor provides solutions that ensure safe and controlled access. Automatic doors equipped with appropriate sensors enhance overall security and protect the premises.

easyAccess.title: Decorative Design
easyAccess.text: GEZE automatic doors can be manufactured using materials such as stone and wood, allowing them to align seamlessly with the overall architectural design. These doors are custom-designed and produced in various dimensions to meet specific aesthetic requirements.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Automatic doors with self-locking capabilities enhance space security and, in emergency situations such as fires or the prevention of smoke and toxic gas intrusion, help ensure the safety and well-being of occupants.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Shopping Centers)
hero.text: GEZE automatic doors are an ideal solution for shopping centers, malls, and large hypermarkets across Iran. These doors are not limited to entry and exit functions; they are an integral part of space management infrastructure. Considering the unique architecture and design of shopping centers, and with a focus on aesthetics and performance, PersiaDoor delivers solutions tailored to customer needs. Modern automatic door designs aim to enhance customer convenience, manage pedestrian traffic efficiently, optimize energy consumption, ensure security, and provide reliable emergency exits.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management and Security
hygiene.text: During peak hours, automatic doors equipped with precise sensors prevent crowd congestion and ensure smooth and orderly pedestrian flow.

easyAccess.title: Energy Optimization
easyAccess.text: Automatic doors in shopping centers contribute to energy optimization by reducing heating, cooling, and ventilation costs.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Automatic doors with self-locking capabilities enhance space security and, in emergency situations such as fires or smoke and toxic gas prevention, help ensure the safety and well-being of visitors.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Bus Terminals & Railway Stations)
hero.text: Bus terminals and railway stations are among the busiest transportation hubs in the country—spaces where thousands of people move every day. Therefore, door systems must ensure safe, fast, and well-organized pedestrian flow. PersiaDoor, leveraging GEZE automatic door technologies, delivers specialized solutions specifically designed for high-traffic environments.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management
hygiene.text: During peak hours, railway stations and terminals experience extremely high foot traffic. GEZE automatic doors, equipped with precise sensors and adjustable configurations, manage passenger entry and exit smoothly without congestion.

easyAccess.title: Flexible Design and Custom Dimensions
easyAccess.text: Terminals and stations differ in layout and space requirements. Some require wide entrances, while others need narrower access points. GEZE doors, with custom dimensions, durable profiles, and specialized designs, integrate seamlessly with waiting halls, corridors, gates, and main entrances.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Transportation hubs operate continuously, and entrances and exits must function 24/7. Persia Service ensures uninterrupted performance through scheduled maintenance and round-the-clock support, maintaining both security and traffic flow at all times.

services.title: 24/7 Service and Support
services.text: Persia Service provides periodic inspections and 24/7 support to guarantee the reliable operation of door systems at all times. In such environments, door malfunctions can disrupt the entire traffic flow, making durability and system quality critically important.

hero.title: Industrial Solutions (Airports)
hero.text: Airports are among the most sensitive and high-traffic facilities in any country, where security, speed, and uninterrupted performance are critical. As the exclusive representative of GEZE Germany, Persiadoor delivers specialized solutions for the smart management of entrances and access control in airport environments. Automatic doors are designed to handle extremely high volumes of passenger traffic with reliability and precision.

howSection.title: How Automatic Doors Support Airport Operations

hygiene.title: Smooth and Efficient Passenger Flow
hygiene.text: In airports, managing passenger movement through entrances, exits, and transition areas is essential. GEZE doors, equipped with highly accurate sensors, fast response times, and customizable settings, guide traffic efficiently without congestion or disruption.

easyAccess.title: Secure Access Control
easyAccess.text: Due to strict security requirements, airports demand highly reliable and precise entry and exit systems. Based on installation location, emergency routes, and each airport’s specific security needs, Persiadoor equips and configures doors with safety standards, locking mechanisms, protective systems, and specialized access control solutions.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Airports operate around the clock, and entrances and exits must function 24/7 without interruption. Through scheduled maintenance and round-the-clock support, Persia Service ensures that automatic doors operate flawlessly at all times, maintaining both security and the speed of passenger movement.

hero.title: Industrial Solutions (Banks)
hero.text: In banks, selecting and installing automatic doors is not merely a technical decision; it is a strategic choice that directly impacts security, efficiency, and user experience. In such environments, doors must operate reliably during peak hours and meet the highest standards in design, mechanical performance, safety, and access control.

howSection.title: How Automatic Doors Support Your Business

hygiene.title: Smooth and Fast Traffic Flow
hygiene.text: As banks are among the most high-traffic environments, even minor disruptions in door performance can lead to serious issues. Automatic doors equipped with precise and reliable sensors ensure smooth movement and prevent congestion.

easyAccess.title: Secure Access Control
easyAccess.text: The security requirements of banks are far more demanding than those of other spaces. By assessing the location and specific needs of each branch, Persiadoor delivers customized security solutions—from access control configurations to equipping doors with certified security systems.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Uninterrupted performance during business hours is essential for banks. For this reason, scheduled maintenance and 24/7 support are among our dedicated services for this sector. Persiadoor is a trusted partner in ensuring security and fast, reliable service for banking environments.

hero.title: Industrial Solutions (Factories)
hero.text: Factories are high-traffic environments with strict safety requirements. In such settings, selecting the right door has a direct impact on employee safety and operational efficiency. Persiadoor delivers specialized solutions using GEZE automatic doors—products designed in line with global standards and tailored for industrial applications.

howSection.title: How Automatic Doors Support Your Business

hygiene.title: Enhanced Security
hygiene.text: GEZE automatic doors, equipped with secure and intelligent locking systems, restrict unauthorized access and enable fast evacuation of personnel in emergency situations.

easyAccess.title: Traffic Management
easyAccess.text: Precise sensors and adjustable systems control door operation to ensure smooth and efficient movement of people. This helps reduce unnecessary stops and increase workflow speed. Designed for long-term use, these doors operate with minimal wear and breakdowns, making them ideal for production environments.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: GEZE automatic doors feature advanced safety systems that allow them to function as reliable emergency exits. They are engineered to operate safely and dependably in the event of power failure or emergency conditions.

fireSafety.title: Durability, Performance, and Reliability
fireSafety.text: The high build quality of GEZE automatic doors ensures resistance to dust, vibration, and temperature fluctuations, while maintaining minimal wear and high reliability under continuous, heavy-duty use.

hero.title: Industrial Solutions (Hospitals)
hero.text: With a deep understanding of hospital environments, Persiadoor designs solutions to address challenges while ensuring safety. Our hospital doors are crafted according to the highest hygiene standards and equipped with the latest technologies. With their specialized design, these doors provide easy, unobstructed access and promote a hygienic environment through minimal contact. They are also designed to allow sufficient clearance for hospital beds while minimizing airflow when closed.

howSection.title: How Automatic Doors Benefit Your Business

hygiene.title: Hygiene Standards
hygiene.text: Persiadoor’s Hygienic and Hermetic hospital doors meet the highest hygiene standards, making them ideal for sensitive hospital environments. By minimizing contact points and eliminating the need to touch handles, these doors help maintain hygiene, while advanced sensors ensure user safety.

easyAccess.title: Easy and Efficient Access
easyAccess.text: Automatic doors facilitate smooth entry and exit, especially for wheelchair users and patients on stretchers. In high-traffic areas, they prevent congestion and reduce waiting times.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Hospital emergency exit doors prevent the entry of smoke and toxic gases during fires. When connected to a fire alarm system, they close automatically and, in case of power failure, link to emergency lighting to provide sufficient illumination for safe passage. Doors with Break-out functionality also allow manual outward opening when needed.

fireSafety.title: 24/7 Service and Support
fireSafety.text: Persiadoor ensures optimal performance of installed systems through regular maintenance, round-the-clock support, and rapid on-site assistance, guaranteeing uninterrupted operation even during peak hours.

hero.text: PersiaDoor’s service division, supported by highly skilled technicians, is available 24/7 to deliver reliable and professional services nationwide.
